intent: Inspect and refactor ApiExceptionHandler without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Shared kernel of Intake/Ledger integration. @RestControllerAdvice mapping errors to RFC 7807 ProblemDetail: WebExchangeBindException and ServerWebInputException -> 400 with field errors; IllegalArgumentException -> 400; IllegalStateException (event bus overflow, backpressure) -> 503 with Retry-After; no stack traces in bodies.
